title: amocvocab — AMOC observing-array variable vocabulary
description: Schema for amocatlas/vocabulary/amocvocab.yml: the controlled short-name vocabulary for AMOC observing-array quantities, extending OceanSITES Reference Table 6 where it stops. Single source of truth; vocabulary.rst, the compliance checker, and the published JSON/SKOS are generated from it. Two things this schema CANNOT enforce (checked in CI instead): (1) each quantity's `name` equals its key; (2) referential integrity of `qualifiers`, `admits_qualifiers`, `quantity`/`base`, `decomposition` against the registries; (3) `units` parses under UDUNITS-2 and, when standard_name is set, converts to its CF canonical units (pyudunits2). Every standard_name is either a CF-verified string (cf_status: exact) or null — never a guess.

version.description: Vocabulary version, independent of the amocatlas package version. Matches entries' `since`.

cf_standard_name_table.description: CF standard-name table version every cf_status decision was checked against, e.g. 'v94 (2026-06-09)'. Re-verify entries when bumped.

reserved_suffixes.description: Suffixes never part of a base short name (applied programmatically): _ERR (uncertainty), _QC (quality flag).

qualifier_classes.description: Closed set of qualifier axes that `admits_qualifiers` may reference.

qualifiers.description: Closed set of qualifier suffix codes and how they compose. A qualified name (e.g. MHT_OT) is base + qualifiers applied in ascending `order`.

order.description: Composition order (low-to-high) so generated names are deterministic.

decompositions.description: Named component sets referenced by an entry's `decomposition` (spec section 6.2, e.g. rapid_fc_ekman_umo). For 0.1 every decomposition is `status: provisional` until its scheme reference is confirmed.

of.description: Base quantity the decomposition sums to (short name).

closure.description: exact: components sum to the total by construction. approximate: sum within `closure_tolerance`. incomplete: a subset; total not recoverable (closure check stays silent).

closure_tolerance.description: Stated tolerance for an `approximate` closure (required when `closure: approximate`), e.g. '0.5 Sv'.

closure_statistic.description: Statistic the `closure_tolerance` applies to: `max` for exact float64 budgets; `median`/`robust_mad` for rounded or glitch-prone sources.

closure_verified.description: Free-text record of a closure check run against real data (dataset, records, residual statistic).

reference.description: DOI/URL of the published scheme. Null allowed only while `status: provisional`.

status.description: provisional: scheme reference not yet confirmed (0.1 default). published: `reference` resolves.

quantities.description: One entry per short name. Keys are UPPERCASE with underscore separators, no doubled underscores, no leading digit, and must not end in a reserved suffix.

name.description: The short name; must equal the key (checked in CI).

quantity.description: Base quantity this term measures, e.g. MHT_EKMAN -> MHT.

kind.description: Closed list from spec section 4; fixes dimensionality, default units, and which qualifiers may apply. Point measurements (TEMP/PSAL/PRES/...) are out of scope (OceanSITES Table 6). `velocity` covers VCUR decomposition components pending the section 4 vs 5a reconciliation.

definition.description: A sentence a scientist can act on.

cf_status.description: exact: a CF standard_name applies and its units are convertible -> standard_name set. units_incompatible: a CF name names the concept but its canonical units are not convertible to `units` (e.g. freshwater transport in sverdrup vs CF kg s-1) -> standard_name null, cf_related names it. none: no CF name exists -> standard_name null.

standard_name.description: CF standard name; non-null ONLY when cf_status == exact. Never a guess.

cf_related.description: Nearest CF concept when cf_status != exact (informational; not written to files as standard_name).

cf_note.description: Why cf_status != exact, with what was checked and when. Required unless cf_status == exact.

p02.description: SeaDataNet P02 URI, or null. NEVER invent — verify against vocab.nerc.ac.uk.

p01.description: BODC P01 URI, or null. NEVER invent — verify against vocab.nerc.ac.uk.

units.description: UDUNITS-2-parseable (lowercase spelled-out names, e.g. 'sverdrup', 'PW', 'degree_C'). Validated with pyudunits2 in CI.

units_alternatives.description: Other acceptable units, each convertible to `units`.

cell_methods.description: CF cell_methods when this term is a reduction of a field that shares its standard_name (e.g. MOC = maximum of the overturning streamfunction -> 'DEPTH: maximum'). This is what distinguishes MOC from PSI at the same standard_name; instances must carry it. The vertical coordinate follows the term's coordinate qualifier (SIGMA0/SIGMA2).

sign_convention.description: Sign meaning, e.g. 'Positive northward.' Required for signed quantities.

decomposition.description: Name of a decomposition (key in top-level `decompositions`) this term participates in.

qualifiers.description: Applied qualifier codes, in canonical order.

admits_qualifiers.description: Which qualifier classes may be applied to this quantity.

reference_pressure.description: For sigma/density quantities: reference pressure in dbar (0 for sigma0, 2000 for sigma2).

source_names.description: Original variable names in provider files, for traceability (spec section 3).

source_long_name.description: Provider long_name(s) preserved when the amocvocab long_name (C1) replaces them. Provenance: never destroy the upstream wording.

cf_proposal.description: URL of a CF-convention proposal to add this name upstream (spec section 12).

cf_proposal_status.description: State of the CF proposal, if any.

since.description: Vocabulary version this entry was introduced.

superseded_by.description: Short name that replaces this one; required (non-null) when status != current.

deprecated_in.description: Vocabulary version in which this term was deprecated (spec section 10).

allOf.comment: cf_status exact <-> standard_name is a non-empty string.
Non-current entries must name their replacement.
Signed quantities must state their sign convention.
